result.topic_en: A Latin passage on characteristic numbers of binary quadratic forms (congruence conditions for non-residues modulo 8, 3, 41 and a sign convention for negative-determinant forms), with unrelated margin and lower-page jottings on hyperbolic/exponential expressions and differential relations in triangles involving a function φ.
